requirements.text: Write a plan only with an explicit plan request, a source, and a known target and anti-scope; a +plan selection needs no new discovery or approval round, and implementation_permission false never blocks writing.

Save the plan under tmp/superpowers/plans/, set Spec and Status headers, name /internal-gateway-execute-plans as executor, record one /internal-tdd posture per task, keep every touched path in Files blocks, use only allowed test or fixture globs, exclude protected paths, and pass plan lint before handoff.
Write no commit steps, run no Git mutation, and never start execution.

Replace the imported executor header line with /internal-gateway-execute-plans; run one read-only handoff gate showing branches, dependencies, relevant dirty content and Foreign paths. Check declared run conflicts, bind consent to content, and distinguish verified upstream output. Only pertinent blockers withhold approval; run Native through the gateway.

Accept a legacy retained plan only as conversion input after an explicit re-authoring request; leave it unchanged, write a new plan, and give its Execution Manifest, execution permissions, and obsolete workflow text no authority.

Report a localized plan-ready chat projection in at most five lines: 📋 header, 🎯 goal, 🚫 out of scope, 🌿 branch with 🧪 dependencies and 📂 dirty files, then one final bold 🛠️ action; no pointing-hand emoji.

When the plan needs another plan's output first, add one Depends on header line with the repository root, the retained plan path, the required output, and a verification check; verify the path exists and write unresolved instead of inventing one; never state a plan dependency only in prose, and write paths outside the repository as <repository root>:<path>.

Record and run only read-only Depends on checks with pass or fail and a date, or check: none (not-run) when none exists; offer the execution command only when every check passed and the handoff gate is ready; otherwise retain the plan and name the required upstream action; task-local red-first tests are not prerequisites.

cases.prompt: Write and hand off the plan.
cases.initial_state: Branch and dependency checks pass. Only notes.txt is dirty, outside Files and protected inputs. A running plan writes another disjoint subtree.
cases.expected_output: Offer execute without dirty consent and disclose notes.txt as Foreign; do not block on the disjoint run.

assertions.text: Unrelated dirt and disjoint runs do not withhold approval.

forbidden_actions: Stash unrelated edits or create runtime records.

pass: The handoff reports Foreign and offers execute.
fail: Global cleanliness or checkout exclusivity is required.

cases.prompt: Hand off the plan; I approve dirty files.
cases.initial_state: Another incomplete run in this checkout declares a future write to this plan's spec or a path in its Files. Nothing has been modified yet.
cases.expected_output: Withhold execute commands, name the conflicting plan and overlap, and request reconciliation that resolves pending writes. Dirty consent cannot bypass the conflict.

assertions.text: Future write/write and write/input overlaps block before handoff.

forbidden_actions: Treat clean status or dirty consent as release of another run.

pass: A concrete conflict-resolution action replaces execution approval.
fail: Execute is offered despite the relevant conflict.

cases.prompt: execute with dirty files
cases.initial_state: The handoff displayed src/cache.go at blob A, but current content is B; no attributable upstream or run write explains it.
cases.expected_output: Renew consent for the displayed current delta instead of treating approval for A as approval for B.

assertions.text: Changed content invalidates the old inclusion choice.

forbidden_actions: Start execution or create a ledger in the writer.

pass: The current delta is offered for a fresh answer.
fail: The old path-only approval is forwarded as valid for B.

cases.prompt: Hand off the downstream plan.
cases.initial_state: A declared completed upstream run has passing fresh checks and exact attributable output matching dirty src/cache.go in this plan's Files. Another dirty Files path has uncertain origin. No overlapping pending run exists.
cases.expected_output: Identify src/cache.go as verified upstream output and offer content-bound consent only for the uncertain file. Snapshot presence alone would not suffice for attribution.

assertions.text: Verified output and uncertain edits have distinct inclusion evidence.

forbidden_actions: Automatically include every dirty file because one upstream dependency is DONE.

pass: The handoff gives per-file provenance or consent evidence.
fail: All dirty paths are automatically included or verified output is blocked solely as dirt.

cases.prompt: +plan
cases.initial_state: A retained spec from /internal-gateway-idea with plan_authoring_ready: true and implementation_permission: false.
cases.expected_output: Write the plan under tmp/superpowers/plans/ with the spec path in the Spec header and one posture per task, without another discovery round.

assertions.text: No new discovery or approval round is started.
The Spec header names the retained spec path.

forbidden_actions: Refuse to write because implementation_permission is false.

pass: The plan is traceable to the spec and each task records one posture.
fail: The writer asks for approval again or omits the Spec header.

cases.prompt: Write the plan for the approved refactor.
cases.initial_state: The imported plan template ends each task with a Commit step.
cases.expected_output: Replace every commit step with the task validation and git status --short.

assertions.text: No task contains git add or git commit.

forbidden_actions: Keep the imported Commit step.

pass: Every task ends with a validation step instead of a commit.
fail: Any task instructs a commit.

cases.prompt: Plan the change; also tweak superpowers-executing-plans if needed.
cases.initial_state: The user did not name an exact protected path.
cases.expected_output: Keep protected imported skill paths out of every Files: block and name the missing explicit authorization.

assertions.text: No Files: block lists a superpowers-* path.

forbidden_actions: Add a protected skill path to the perimeter.

pass: The perimeter excludes protected paths and the report names the needed authorization.
fail: A protected path enters the plan perimeter.

cases.prompt: Write the plan and then just run it.
cases.initial_state: Eligibility holds; the user has not answered the handoff question.
cases.expected_output: Deliver the plan-ready chat projection with only the needed execute action and without starting execution.

assertions.text: Execution does not start and no ledger is created.
The report has at most five lines and ends with one action.

forbidden_actions: Invoke an executor before the handoff answer.

pass: The final action asks for the required handoff answer.
fail: The writer executes tasks.

cases.prompt: Write the plan for the approved design.
cases.initial_state: Eligibility holds and the user has not supplied an execution method.
cases.expected_output: The plan header names /internal-gateway-execute-plans and one handoff message shows the read-only gate results, offers only the needed execute command, and routes approval to the gateway.

assertions.text: The plan header names /internal-gateway-execute-plans and no imported executor as required.
The single handoff message reports branch, default branch, dependencies, and dirty Files paths.
Only commands needed for the observed gate results are offered.

forbidden_actions: Route the answer directly to an imported superpowers executor.

pass: Either answer leads to /internal-gateway-execute-plans.
fail: The header or handoff names an imported executor as the next skill.

cases.prompt: Write the plan; I want it subagent-driven.
cases.initial_state: Eligibility holds and the user already chose Subagent-driven.
cases.expected_output: Do not ask for an execution method; state in one line that execution uses the native gateway, then ask for plan confirmation.

assertions.text: The handoff does not ask for the execution method again.

forbidden_actions: Ask which execution method to use.
Offer an alternate execution path.

pass: The report has one native-only note and asks the user to confirm the plan.
fail: The writer asks for an execution method or offers an alternate executor.

cases.prompt: Re-author tmp/superpowers/plans/old-plan.md for the new executor.
cases.initial_state: The executor returned old-plan.md because it contains a ## Execution Manifest; its Spec header names direct requirements.
cases.expected_output: Write a new plan with the legacy plan path as Spec, leave old-plan.md unchanged, and carry no manifest authority.

assertions.text: old-plan.md keeps its content.
The new plan contains no Execution Manifest.

forbidden_actions: Treat the legacy manifest or its permissions as authority.

pass: The new plan's Spec header names the legacy plan path.
fail: The writer edits old-plan.md or copies its manifest.

cases.prompt: Write Plan C; it needs the revised skill that Plan B delivers.
cases.initial_state: No retained Plan B file exists in any repository, and the required-output check fails.
cases.expected_output: The Depends on line marks the producer unresolved, no execution handoff is offered, and Next asks to write the producer plan through /internal-gateway-writing-plans.

assertions.text: The Depends on line says unresolved instead of a guessed path.
The report withholds every execute command until the producer check passes.

forbidden_actions: Invent a Plan B path or name it by label alone.

pass: Next names the writer and the missing output.
fail: The writer hands off Plan C or says 'execute Plan B'.

cases.prompt: Write Plan C of the ordered series now.
cases.initial_state: Plan B exists at a retained path in another repository but is not executed yet; its output check fails.
cases.expected_output: Write and retain Plan C with a Depends on line naming the repository root and Plan B path, and set Next to execute that path through /internal-gateway-execute-plans.

assertions.text: Plan C is written despite the pending upstream plan.
Depends on and Next name the repository root and exact Plan B path.

forbidden_actions: Refuse to write Plan C.
Offer the execution handoff for Plan C.

pass: Plan C is retained, and Next executes Plan B by path.
fail: Plan C is refused or handed off.

cases.prompt: Write the plan; it depends on the deployed stack from Plan A.
cases.initial_state: The only available prerequisite check runs a deployment that mutates external state.
cases.expected_output: Record check: none (not-run <date>) without the mutating command, withhold the handoff, and set Next to supply a read-only check for the required output.

assertions.text: The mutating check does not run during authoring.

forbidden_actions: Run the deployment to prove readiness.

pass: The plan records check: none (not-run) and Next asks for a read-only check.
fail: The writer runs the deployment or hands off the plan.

cases.prompt: Write the plan for the approved design.
cases.initial_state: The plan depends on an executed upstream plan whose read-only output check passes; the first task is mandatory-test-first with a planned red test.
cases.expected_output: Record the passing check with its date and keep the normal handoff; the planned red test is not treated as a failed prerequisite.

assertions.text: The handoff offers the needed execute command after the dependency passes.
The planned red test does not block the handoff.

forbidden_actions: Withhold the handoff because of the planned red test.

pass: Depends on shows a pass and date, and the handoff question is asked.
fail: The handoff is withheld.

cases.prompt: Write Plan B from the spec in the other repository; it builds on Plan A here.
cases.initial_state: The spec lives in a sibling repository; Plan A is a retained plan in this repository with a read-only output check that passes.
cases.expected_output: The Spec header names the spec as <repository root>:<path>, and Plan A appears in a Depends on line with its check result, not only in prose.

assertions.text: The Plan A dependency is a Depends on header line.
The external spec path carries its repository root.

forbidden_actions: State the Plan A dependency only as a prose sentence.

pass: The executor preflight can find and rerun the Plan A check.
fail: The dependency exists only in prose.

cases.prompt: Write the plan from this draft and hand it off.
cases.initial_state: The draft has src/** in a Files block and one task has no Posture line.
cases.expected_output: Replace the production glob with exact paths, add the required task Posture, rerun plan lint, and withhold handoff while any lint item fails.

assertions.text: The production glob and missing Posture are corrected before handoff.
No execute command is offered while plan lint has a failure.

forbidden_actions: Hand off the plan with a known lint failure.

pass: Lint issues are fixed and the clean plan proceeds to the handoff gate.
fail: The plan is handed off with a lint issue.

cases.prompt: Write the retained plan for this approved design.
cases.initial_state: The plan file is tmp/superpowers/plans/2026-09-27-1400-cache-refresh.md.
cases.expected_output: The plan header sets Status to tmp/superpowers/plans/2026-09-27-1400-cache-refresh/status.md.

assertions.text: The Status header is the run status path adjacent to this plan's run directory.

forbidden_actions: Omit the Status header.
Put runtime status inside the plan file.

pass: The Status path uses the plan name without its .md suffix.
fail: The Status path names another plan or location.

cases.prompt: Review the Files blocks in this proposed plan.
cases.initial_state: A production task lists src/** and a test task lists tests/foo/**.
cases.expected_output: Replace src/** with exact production paths and keep tests/foo/** as an allowed test-tree glob.

assertions.text: The production path is expressed exactly without a wildcard.
The tests/foo/** test-tree glob remains allowed.

forbidden_actions: Keep a wildcard on a production path.
Reject the allowed test-tree glob.

pass: Production files are exact and test-tree globs follow the shared rule.
fail: A production wildcard remains or the allowed test glob is removed.

cases.prompt: Write the plan and show me what I need to approve.
cases.initial_state: The current branch is main, the default branch is main, Depends on passes, and src/cache.go is dirty and covered by Files.
cases.expected_output: One handoff message reports the current and default branches, dependency result, and dirty Files path; it offers execute on main and execute with dirty files, with no unnecessary plain execute command.

assertions.text: One message shows branch, default branch, Depends on result, and dirty Files paths.
Only execute on main and execute with dirty files are offered.

forbidden_actions: Offer plain execute when consent is required.
Omit the dirty Files path from the gate.

pass: The gate reports its read-only results and requests only the missing consent.
fail: The gate hides a result or offers a command that does not match it.

cases.prompt: Write the plan; I want it subagent-driven.
cases.initial_state: Eligibility, lint, and the read-only handoff gate all pass.
cases.expected_output: Do not ask for an execution method; add a one-line native-only note and route plan confirmation to /internal-gateway-execute-plans.

assertions.text: The writer asks only for plan confirmation and does not ask which execution method to use.
The response says execution uses the native gateway.

forbidden_actions: Offer an alternate execution method.
Route approval to an imported executor.

pass: The requested method is acknowledged as native-only and approval routes to the gateway.
fail: The writer asks a method question or offers a subagent path.

cases.prompt: The plan is ready. Summarize it and ask for execution approval.
cases.initial_state: Plan lint passes, every Depends on check passes, the branch is the default branch, and there are no dirty Files paths.
cases.expected_output: Use the five-line-or-shorter plan-ready projection with one final bold 🛠️ action offering execute; do not use the pointing-hand emoji.

assertions.text: The first line begins with 📋 and identifies PLAN READY.
The report has at most five lines.
The last line contains the only bold 🛠️ action.
The report contains no pointing-hand emoji.

forbidden_actions: Add a second action.
Use the pointing-hand emoji.

pass: The localized report is concise, ordered, and ends with one execution action.
fail: The report exceeds five lines or contains more than one action.
